notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
I am so happy to announce the release of my demo for "Farmyard Survivors"!

In the demo you can do unlimited runs and test all skill animals. What is missing in the demo and will be available in the full version of the game:

[list]
[*] Five different playable characters
[*] Upgrade your character
[*] Upgrade your skill animals
[*] Elemental damage dealing defense structures
[*] Have up to six skill animals at once
[/list]

The release of the full version is planned for 17th March 2025. 

Tell me what you think by joining the discord, writing a review and/or writing a post in the community section of steam. I really look forward to it.

And now: Have fun with the demo :)
